newsitem.title: USA: Wellpoint to acquire Hancock health plan.
newsitem.headline: Wellpoint to acquire Hancock health plan.

text.p: WellPoint Health Networks Inc said Friday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire John Hancock Mutual Life Insurance Co's group health and related life business for $86.7 million.
John Hancock's nearly 1.4 million members of the health and life service boosts WellPoint's size to over 5.5 million medical members throughout the United States.
The acquisition also includes Hancock's managed care services subsidiary, Cost Care Inc, but excludes its group long-term care and stand-alone group life businesses.
The deal is expected to close no later than Jan. 31, 1997.
